## Summary
Provide a clear and concise summary of the feature request.

## Problem to solve
What problem does this solve? Who is affected and why?

## Proposed solution
Describe the solution at a high level. Add diagrams, flows, or pseudo-code if helpful.

## Scope
- In scope: ...
- Out of scope: ...

## Alternatives considered
List alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Clear, testable criterion 1
- [ ] Clear, testable criterion 2
- [ ] Clear, testable criterion 3

## Impact and risks
Note performance, security, UX, accessibility, or breaking changes.

## Testing considerations
How will this be tested? Unit/E2E scenarios, test data, or mocks.

## Additional context
Links, references, related issues/PRs, mockups/screens.

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched for duplicates and did not find an existing request.
- [ ] This is a feature request, not a question or bug report.
- [ ] I am willing to contribute a PR or help with implementation.
